limits: Original full-character retro drawing adaptation of first Metal Gear AC!D Teliko; not captured publisher pixel artwork and not an absolute 1:1 hardware palette certificate.
46 mapped independently illustrated complete native bodies across four PNGs; four other upright calibration bodies measure shared supplement scale but are not selected as animation frames.
Original source V1 and V2 twelve-pose preparations remain intact and private; no generated source PNG pixels have been edited, resized, mirrored or repixelated.
Alpha16 body completeness and metadata clipping exclude adjacent bodies. Alpha below16 outer fringes are not a pixel-exact source-outline certificate.

SourceStandingHeight uses measured source idle bodies; dual supplementary sheets use two-direction median, ±1percent variation. Source datum axes manually reviewed against pelvis, not centered by weapon reach.
Hit and lying KO intentionally rotate the body through recoil/defeat; face orientation in these reactions is qualified, while all neutral/movement/attack/weapon directions are independently drawn.
Original actionMap, original six phase mappings, fighter profile, hitboxes, physics and ammunition remain unchanged. New deploy three-phase map supplies actual wind-up, extension and recovery.
Fresh actual selection/combat browser QA in standalone and embedded routes remains required before reporting the costume as publicly tested.
